$comment: Spec pins for the design-conformance functional-acceptance suite (cinatra#985). Each entry pins the EXACT generated conformance manifest this repo verified against: `manifestSha256` is the sha256 of the committed manifest bytes under manifests/, `specContentHash` is the manifest's embedded spec-source hash (must match the manifest's own contentHash field). `source: "repo"` = pre-publication REPO-PIN fallback: the suite reads the committed manifest copy (verbatim generated bytes from cinatra-ai/design, never hand-edited). Once the docs wave publishes the manifests under publishedBaseUrl, flip `source` to "published" — NO code change: the suite then ALSO fetches the published manifest and asserts its bytes hash to `manifestSha256` (upstream drift = a distinct, actionable red). To adopt a new upstream manifest version: replace the file under manifests/ with the regenerated artifact and update both hashes in the same commit.
